t: Sylvania Toledo E14 Mini Globe LED light bulb offers an efficient and long-lasting solution for various electrical fittings. Ideal for general purpose lighting in commercial environments, residential properties, or DIY installations where reliable, instant light is essential. This frosted mini globe bulb provides 470 lumens of uniform, instant light with a low power consumption of 4.2W, ensuring good colour rendering (CRI 80). Serves as a direct replacement for traditional halogen, incandescent, and compact fluorescent lamps, making upgrades straightforward. Designed for durability, the bulb has an average rated life of 15,000 hours, reducing maintenance requirements and ensuring consistent performance.
